home2_title: Find a good tutor in Zimbabwe
home2_meta: Tutora helps students and parents in Zimbabwe find a tutor and book lessons online or in person.

home2_step2_t: Book a lesson or a free intro chat
home2_step2: Pick a free time. The tutor confirms it.
home2_step3: Join online with low data, or meet in person. Get a receipt for every payment.
